title: -(으)면 안 되다 prohibición
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide treats **-(으)면 안 되다** as a unitary expression and documents the forms **찾으면/가면/놀면 안 되다**. The construction conveys prohibition; the guide cautions that it is not formed as **-으면 되지 않는다**. This entry is limited to those forms and the documented prohibition.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 593–594 (printed pp. 581–582): form table and sentence-structure restrictions for -(으)면 안 되다.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con construcciones de permiso como **-아/어도 되다**, que expresa que una acción está permitida, y con formas de obligación como **-아/어야 하다**. Juntas muestran distintos valores de permiso, prohibición y necesidad.
